requirements.description: Hi-Lo compares two standard-card ranks with ace high and suits ignored, using the server-owned visible-rank paytable for a correct prediction, a 1x equal-rank refund, and a 0x incorrect result.
requirements.notes: Issue #406 retains the deprecated frozen-v1 correct-return scalar at 2 while an additive server-owned 0.96x-through-1.93x rank table becomes authoritative for settlement and visible EN/RU rules.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe Hi-Lo active decisions, recent rounds, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Normal-user session context overrides caller-supplied player ids, and settled Hi-Lo history survives backend restart.

requirements.description: Hi-Lo wager debits, equal-rank refunds, and winning payouts use the shared ledger exactly once under stable action identifiers and immutable request fingerprints.
requirements.notes: Game code never mutates balances directly; exact deal and guess retries recover immutable ledger proof, rank-priced credits retain the authoritative multiplier, and changed wagers or directions fail closed.

requirements.description: The Hi-Lo surface provides complete English and Russian copy and remains responsive, accessible, and reduced-motion safe across required viewports and decision outcomes.
requirements.notes: Acceptance evidence covers both locales, all four named viewports, ready and choice states, correct, incorrect, and tie settlements, reduced motion, and canonical route restoration.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery automatically include Hi-Lo with requirement, module, version, and visual evidence traceability.
requirements.notes: The descriptor uses sort order 120; the normalized tests.game_drivers.hi_lo:play driver verifies fractional-wager settlement against the published rank table at ledger precision.
